# Open-Source License Compatibility Review

## Purpose
Screens declared software licenses and dependency obligations for a proposed project combination.

## Workflow
1. Identify exact project versions and authoritative license files.
2. Record SPDX identifiers where available and distinguish declared license from missing or ambiguous metadata.
3. Build a dependency inventory and map distribution, modification, notice, attribution, source-offer, and patent obligations.
4. Flag incompatible or legally uncertain combinations for qualified counsel.
5. Never infer permission from repository visibility.

## Output
License inventory, dependency obligation matrix, provenance links, uncertainty register, and counsel-review questions.

## Safety and limits
- Not legal advice; do not give a definitive legal clearance. Do not copy or redistribute code. Verify exact versions and license texts. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
